{"code":"local function resolve_attack(attacker, defender, skill)
  local fl = math.floor
  local function cl(x, lo, hi) if x < lo then return lo elseif x > hi then return hi else return x end end
  local atk = attacker.atk
  local alevel = attacker.level
  local crit_chance = attacker.crit_chance or 0
  local crit_mult = attacker.crit_mult or 150
  local pen_pct = attacker.pen_pct or 0
  local pen_flat = attacker.pen_flat or 0
  local hp = defender.hp
  local shield = defender.shield or 0
  local armor = defender.armor
  local dlevel = defender.level
  local def_elem = defender.element
  local resist = defender.resist or {}
  local guarding = defender.guarding
  local power = skill.power
  local element = skill.element or 'physical'
  local hits = skill.hits or 1
  local true_damage = skill.true_damage
  local seed = skill.seed or 0
  local m
  if element == 'fire' then
    if def_elem == 'fire' then m = 50 elseif def_elem == 'water' then m = 50 elseif def_elem == 'nature' then m = 200 else m = 100 end
  elseif element == 'water' then
    if def_elem == 'fire' then m = 200 elseif def_elem == 'water' then m = 50 elseif def_elem == 'nature' then m = 50 else m = 100 end
  elseif element == 'nature' then
    if def_elem == 'fire' then m = 50 elseif def_elem == 'water' then m = 200 elseif def_elem == 'nature' then m = 50 else m = 100 end
  else
    if def_elem == 'ghost' then m = 0 else m = 100 end
  end
  local rr = resist[element]
  if rr == nil then rr = 0 end
  rr = cl(rr, -50, 80)
  local diff = cl(alevel - dlevel, -10, 10)
  local start_hp = hp
  local absorbed = 0
  local crits = 0
  local resolved = 0
  local overkill = 0
  local killed = false
  for k = 1, hits do
    local p = power - 20 * (k - 1)
    if p < 10 then p = 10 end
    local d = fl(atk * p / 100)
    d = fl(d * (100 + 3 * diff) / 100)
    local iscrit = ((seed + 17 * k) % 100) < crit_chance
    if iscrit then d = fl(d * crit_mult / 100) end
    local immune = false
    if not true_damage then
      local pen = pen_pct
      if iscrit then pen = pen * 2 end
      if pen > 100 then pen = 100 end
      local ea = fl(armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - pen_flat
      if ea < 0 then ea = 0 end
      d = fl(d * 100 / (100 + ea))
      d = fl(d * m / 100)
      if m == 0 then immune = true end
      d = fl(d * (100 - rr) / 100)
    end
    if guarding then d = fl(d / 2) end
    if d < 1 then
      if immune then d = 0 else d = 1 end
    end
    local a = d
    if shield < a then a = shield end
    shield = shield - a
    local loss = d - a
    if a > 0 and shield == 0 then loss = fl(loss * 125 / 100) end
    absorbed = absorbed + a
    resolved = resolved + 1
    if iscrit then crits = crits + 1 end
    if loss >= hp then
      overkill = loss - hp
      hp = 0
      killed = true
      break
    else
      hp = hp - loss
    end
  end
  return {damage = start_hp - hp, absorbed = absorbed, hp = hp, shield = shield, overkill = overkill, crits = crits, hits = resolved, killed = killed}
end
local r1 = resolve_attack({atk=40,level=12,crit_chance=30,crit_mult=150,pen_pct=25,pen_flat=5},{hp=60,shield=10,armor=40,level=10,element='nature',resist={fire=20},guarding=false},{power=120,element='fire',hits=2,true_damage=false,seed=3})
local r2 = resolve_attack({atk=90,level=3,crit_chance=50,crit_mult=200,pen_pct=40,pen_flat=10},{hp=300,shield=25,armor=60,level=20,element='fire',resist={water=-30},guarding=true},{power=100,element='water',hits=3,true_damage=false,seed=40})
local function fmt(t)
  return '{damage='..tostring(t.damage)..',absorbed='..tostring(t.absorbed)..',hp='..tostring(t.hp)..',shield='..tostring(t.shield)..',overkill='..tostring(t.overkill)..',crits='..tostring(t.crits)..',hits='..tostring(t.hits)..',killed='..tostring(t.killed)..'}'
end
return 'E1 '..fmt(r1)..' E2 '..fmt(r2)"}

{"code":"logic_define('attack_damage', function(attacker_power, defender_armor)
  local dmg = attacker_power - defender_armor
  if dmg < 1 then dmg = 1 end
  return dmg
end)

logic_define('apply_damage', function(hp, damage)
  local new_hp = hp - damage
  if new_hp < 0 then new_hp = 0 end
  return new_hp
end)

logic_define('is_dead', function(hp)
  return hp <= 0
end)

report('Defined turn-based combat logic slots: attack_damage, apply_damage, is_dead')"}
